source.title: Open problems in the combinatorics of visibility and illumination

trace.notes: Normalized the input as a zbMATH bibliographic resolver URL with trailing identifier 1241843.

The zbMATH landing URL did not yield a readable full-text artifact through the available page reader. Local shell fetches of zbmath.org, api.zbmath.org, science.smith.edu, and ams.org failed with DNS resolution errors in the sandbox, so direct local resolver, API, HTML, and PDF downloads could not be completed.

Local workflow metadata for the same source records the title, year 1999, and the DOI 10.1090/conm/223/03140. This metadata was used only for source identity and title recovery, not for question extraction.

Ran exact-work recovery attempts using the zbMATH identifier, exact title, DOI, AMS Contemporary Mathematics volume 223 pages 237-243, Joseph O'Rourke's publication page, and the Smith College recent-solutions page. The AMS eBook and bookstore pages exposed only table-of-contents or purchase metadata through the available reader. The Smith College Open.html page visible in search results was an ancillary recent-solutions page and could not be opened with stable source locators; its snippets were not treated as the primary technical source. Search snippets, bibliographic records, table-of-contents pages, purchase pages, and related ResearchGate pages for different works were rejected as extraction sources.

No candidates were mapped, extracted, rewritten, or accepted because no readable full-text artifact could be confirmed and accessed as the same exact zbMATH source. The workflow forbids extracting questions from resolver metadata, abstracts, catalog pages, table-of-contents pages, search snippets, ancillary notices without stable locators, or related but different works.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/1241843.json and outputs/latest.json.
